name: The Goodies
description: A British television comedy series of the 1970s and early 1980s, combining surreal sketches and situation comedy.

videos.title: Return of the Goodies
videos.overview: The Goodies finally return to television after nearly 25 years with a compilation of classic clips, interviews and new material.

videos.title: A Collection of Goodies
videos.overview: A lack of finances sees Tim filling out a Tax Evasion form for the Goodies, with Graeme’s computer providing timely reminders of the bizarre items which he is trying to claim for.

videos.title: Goodies Travelling Instant 5 Minute Christmas
videos.overview: In a super-condensed series of Christmas themed events, Tim, Graham and Bill sing a number of carols, put the boy to bed and then arrange for a visit from Santa...

videos.title: DVD Extras - Gymnasium
videos.overview: Originally shown as part of the 'Engelbert With the Young Generation' series and subsequently compiled into 'A Collection of Goodies' (aka 'Special Tax Edition').

videos.title: DVD Extras - Crackerjack Clip
videos.overview: The Goodies sing "A Man's Best Friend is His Duck" on Crackerjack.

videos.title: Broaden Your Mind
videos.overview: Very little exists of the 1968/1969 pre-cursor to The Goodies.  Presented here are the 35mm film inserts to one show that would have been seen at various points in the episode interspersed with other material recorded on videotape in the studio.  This material is sourced directly from the original film and is presented without the audience reaction, which would have been part of the original broadcast.

videos.title: DVD Extras - Digital Restoration Feature 1
videos.overview: Scenes and commentary on the problems facing the restoration team.

videos.title: DVD Extras - Storyboard for The Goodies and the Beanstalk
DVD Extras Easter Egg - Timeclock
videos.overview: Short clip explaining the pre-aired timeclock counting down to live for broadcast of one of the episodes.  Includes audio of Bill Oddie and Tim Brooke-Taylor yelping and scrambling to get ready with 10 seconds to air.

videos.title: DVD Extras Easter Egg - Station Ident
videos.overview: BBC station identification leading in to opening credits.

videos.title: DVD Extras - Digital Restoration Feature 2
videos.overview: Existing 16mm film elements were examined by Amanda Whitby and digital copies of the existing analogue videotape recordings were compared to ascertain the best source, along with some new transfers from the original 2-inch mastertapes.  Colour grading, noise reduction and reconstruction of 'Come Dancing' episode by Jonathan Wood.

videos.title: Goodies Music Archive - Black Pudding Bertha
Goodies Music Archive - Nappy Love and Wild Thing
Goodies Music Archive - Make a Daft Noise for Christmas
The One Show
videos.overview: The Goodies were once again reunited when the BBC one show, entitled "The One Show", brought them back. It concluded with Tim riding a tandem alone while the others stared / watched.

videos.title: An Audience with The Goodies
videos.overview: Live onstage appearance from Bill Oddie, Graeme Garden and Tim Brooke-Taylor as they discuss their popular 1970s television series at the Leicester Square Theatre in June 2018. In conversation with comedian Stewart Lee and television expert Dick Fiddy, the stars talk about the successes and highlights of their career while taking questions from the audience.

videos.title: Beefeaters
videos.overview: The Goodies are asked to assist in discovering who is stealing the Beefeaters' beef.

videos.title: Snooze
videos.overview: The Goodies are asked to market a bedtime drink called 'Venom'. They decide that the first thing needed is a name change to 'Snooze'.

videos.title: Give Police a Chance
videos.overview: The Goodies are hired to improve the image of the police with the general public.

videos.title: Playgirl Club
videos.overview: The Goodies are asked to recover some sexually explicit photographs of politicians.

videos.title: The Greenies
videos.overview: The Goodies go on holiday to a Cornish village that has been subjected to military takeover.

videos.title: Cecily
videos.overview: The Goodies take a job helping out at a stately home, and meet sweet Cecily, who is not all that she seems...

videos.title: Radio Goodies
videos.overview: The Goodies open a pirate radio station - and post office.

videos.title: The Loch Ness Monster
videos.overview: The Goodies help a suicidal zookeeper to locate a monster for London Zoo's Snowdon Monster House.

videos.title: Commonwealth Games
videos.overview: The Goodies take part in the Commonwealth Games as the British team against the August Bank Holiday Islands - with the entire Commonwealth at stake.

videos.title: Pollution
videos.overview: The land is covered in pollution and the Goodies suspect corruption.

videos.title: The Lost Tribe
videos.overview: The Goodies are asked to find Professor Knutts who went missing whilst leading an expedition to find the Lost Tribe of the Orinoco in 1951. They eventually find him - in Sevenoaks.

videos.title: Music Lovers
videos.overview: Musicians are being kidnapped all over the country, so The Goodies become famous musicians too, eventually get stolen and come face-to-face with their arch-enemy - The Music Master.

videos.title: For Art's Sake
videos.overview: Tim's crusade to stop rich Americans from buying all of Britain's art treasures sees him bidding a huge amount of money for one painting, forcing the Goodies to take drastic action to pay for it.

videos.title: Kitten Kong
videos.overview: The Goodies' Animal Clinic looks after various problem animals, including Twinkle the kitten who, thanks to Graeme's growth formula, grows to a massive size and terrorises London.

videos.title: Dancing
videos.overview: Asked to be part of a formation dancing team, the Goodies find that dancing isn't as gentle and pure as they thought, especially when they encounter Delia Capone and her corrupt team.

videos.title: Farm Fresh Food
videos.overview: Disgusted at the awful cuisine served up at Ye Olde Shepherds Restaurant, the Goodies head to the farm of Tim's uncle for some fresh country food, only to be further disappointed upon arrival.

videos.title: Free to Live
videos.overview: Bill reports Graeme and Tim to the Women's Liberation Front after he disapproves of their treatment of Graeme's new totty. As a punishment, they are sent to work for Lord Charles (a male chauvinist) - Graeme as the butler and Tim as the maid.

videos.title: Gender Education
videos.overview: In response to a proposed appalling BBC film (for schoolchildren, mark you) on S-E-X education, Mrs. Desiree Carthorse - the self-proclaimed most powerful person in the field of television, if not the world, enlists The Goodies to make her version: 'How to Make Babies by Doing Dirty Things'.

videos.title: Charity Bounce AKA London to Brighton
videos.overview: The Goodies are bouncing on space hoppers from London to Brighton for charity. However, they continue to bounce on around the world much to the horror of their tight-fisted sponsor.

videos.title: Double Trouble
videos.overview: The Goodies' bid to win the Nice Person of the Year Award is being sabotaged by the mysterious Dr. Petal and his evil robot doubles of them and other famous people.

videos.title: Kitten Kong (Montreux edition)
videos.overview: The Goodies' Animal Clinic looks after various problem animals, including Twinkle the kitten who, thanks to Graeme's growth formula, grows to a massive size and terrorises London.

videos.title: The New Office
videos.overview: The Goodies need a new office, but after being ripped off in the local estate agent they decide to build their own - a Graeme designed mobile disused railway station.

videos.title: Hunting Pink
videos.overview: Tim is off to spend the weekend at Tally-Ho Towers with his rich Great Uncle Butcher-Fitzsimmons. He is dressed as a Guardsman in the hope that this will impress the old man into leaving him all his money in his will. Bill and Graeme think this is despicable, disgusting - and a very good idea, so they invite themselves along.

videos.title: The Winter Olympics
videos.overview: The Goodies agree to be Britain's team in the Winter Olympics at the North Pole (there's apparently been a lot of snow there recently).

videos.title: That Old Black Magic
videos.overview: Witch Hazel's problems with casting spells leads the Goodies to help her to contact lost souls via a seance, and Graeme's mystical powers eventually see him turned into a gibbon.

videos.title: For Those in Peril on the Sea
videos.overview: Graeme's urge to recreate an early Viking expedition and find the Lost Island Of Munga sees the Goodies shipwrecked and at the mercy of an old foe from a previous show.

videos.title: Way Outward Bound
videos.overview: The failure to find any kids willing to go to an adventure school forces the Goodies to attend disguised as children, only to find that the school is being used for a far more sinister cause.

videos.title: Superstar
videos.overview: Appalled at the offensive songs in the hit parade, the Goodies perform a sickly sweet song on the Maxie Grease Show, but Bill is exploited and turned into a superstar by an unscrupulous agent.

videos.title: Camelot
videos.overview: Tim's Uncle King Arthur (actually Arthur King, but appearing as 'King, Arthur' in the phone book) is away on holiday and the Goodies have to look after his home, firstly turning it into a tourist attraction, then having to defend it from the clutches of the local town planner.

videos.title: Invasion of the Moon Creatures
videos.overview: Graeme's attempt to send rabbits to the moon seems to be a failure until Bill and Tim's space voyage discovers plots of vegetables and the menacing presence of Big Bunny.

videos.title: Hospital for Hire
videos.overview: A bad experience with the hospital system forces the Goodies to become doctors themselves and attempt to fix up the health system with the help of Graeme's magic elixir.

videos.title: The Goodies and the Beanstalk
videos.overview: The Goodies have hit rock-bottom and are forced to sell Buttercup for a tin of baked beans. In an act of desperation, Graeme plants one of the beans...

videos.title: The Stone Age
videos.overview: Graeme discovers an ancient tunnel below the Goodies' office and his penchant for potholing soon finds them stuck inside the stomach of a tyrannosaurus rex.

videos.title: Goodies in the Nick
videos.overview: A timid policeman needs the Goodies' help in boosting his tally of arrests, but their fiendishly cunning bank robbery sees them locked away in prison and desperate to escape.

videos.title: The Race
videos.overview: A wrong turn to Skegness sees the Goodies winning the Tour de France cycling race, so they decide to also enter Le Mans and convert their disused railway station office into a car.

videos.title: The Movies
videos.overview: The Goodies buy a movie studio and attempt to revitalise the British film industry, but ultimately descend into chaos when they each try to shoot their own film at the same time.

videos.title: The Clown Virus
videos.overview: A job to dispose of a harmless can of 'tomato soup' for an American military base sees the whole British population turned into clowns and ripe for an invasion by US troops.

videos.title: Chubby Chumps
videos.overview: Tim has become rather flabby while the others have been away fishing, but trims himself down thanks to a brainwashing radio DJ and enters the Miss Housewife of the Year Contest.

videos.title: Wacky Wales
videos.overview: An invitation to an eisteddfod in Wales has the Goodies in all sorts of trouble with the Reverend after they dare to break many of the puritanical local laws and actually try to entertain people.

videos.title: Frankenfido
videos.overview: Graeme's dog breeding venture gets out of hand and Tim's only chance to win at Crufts is to dress Bill in a dog costume, which forces Graeme to create a shaggy monster of his own.

videos.title: Scatty Safari
videos.overview: The main attraction at The Goodies Star Safari Park, Tony Blackburn, is hearing the call of the wild and pining for his freedom. The trio realise that they can no longer keep such a magnificent beast in captivity, and release him. But who should they get to replace him?

videos.title: Kung Fu Kapers!
videos.overview: Bill reveals himself to be a Grand Master of the infinitely more subtle and superior Lancastrian martial art of Ecky Thump.

videos.title: Lighthouse Keeping Loonies
videos.overview: The Goodies answer an advert for 'a little light housekeeping' and find themselves stuck for five years in charge of an 'overgrown lamp post'.

videos.title: Rome Antics
videos.overview: In 55AD the early Goodies venture to Rome to provide entertainment for the fruit-fancying Emperor, but are eventually confronted by Attila the Hun and the invading Barbarians.

videos.title: Cunning Stunts
videos.overview: Bill is fired from the Goodies' newspaper for being a hopeless reporter and after he is rejected by the love of his life, he decides to end it all by entering the Eurovision Raving Loony Contest.

videos.title: South Africa
videos.overview: The Goodies are forced to emigrate to South Africa where the absence of black people forces a new form of segregation called apart-height, mainly affecting short people like jockeys and Bill.

videos.title: Bunfight at the OK Tearooms
videos.overview: With hardly a penny to their name, the Goodies go prospecting for gold - and discover Cornish cream.

videos.title: The End
videos.overview: The Goodies’ office accidentally gets covered in concrete, leaving them trapped for a century. They desperately try to survive while they grow hungry and slightly mad…

videos.title: Goodies Rule - OK?
videos.overview: The unwanted Goodies finally hit the big time after years of failure, only for the government to topple and all forms of fun to be banned, requiring a civil uprising and a puppet government.

videos.title: Lips, or Almighty Cod
videos.overview: Cod have become so scarce that there is nothing to make fish fingers from.

videos.title: Hype Pressure
videos.overview: Tim invites Bill and Graeme to perform on the talent show he presents.

videos.title: Daylight Robbery on the Orient Express
videos.overview: Goodies Holidays is creating an exciting mystery tour aboard the Orient Express for the Detectives Club, but things go astray when the train is hijacked and taken to the Le Boring Contest.

videos.title: Black and White Beauty
videos.overview: Graeme has established a rest home for clapped-out old animals and is sent a pantomime horse, which Tim trains before it is callously stolen by Bill to enter in the Grand National.

videos.title: It Might as Well be String
videos.overview: A series of too honest ads sees revenue for the Goodies' advertising agency plummet, until Tim discovers the joys of string, and Bill and Graeme set about ripping him off.

videos.title: 2001 and a Bit
videos.overview: The futuristic sons of the Goodies have become bored with the extremely violent forms of modern entertainment and seek to revive something truly civilised from their fathers' era - cricket.

videos.title: The Goodies - Almost Live
videos.overview: A concert featuring many of The Goodies' best known songs, including Cactus in my Y-Fronts, Funky Gibbon, Black Pudding Bertha, Bounce, Last Chance Dance and Wild Thing.

videos.title: Alternative Roots
videos.overview: A historical look back at the ancestors of the Goodies; Celtic Kilty (Graeme), County Cutie (Tim) and Kinda Kinky (Bill) and how they were captured by the evil television slave traders.

videos.title: Dodonuts
videos.overview: Disgusted by Tim and Graeme's love of hunting, Bill vows to protect the last dodo.

videos.title: Scoutrageous
videos.overview: Tim indoctrinates Bill and Graeme into the Scouts, but they take things to extremes resulting in the movement being declared illegal.

videos.title: Punky Business
videos.overview: The punk phenomenon grips Britain as even grannies reject niceness.

videos.title: Royal Command
videos.overview: The revised Royal Variety Show hosted by Graeme is so well received by the royal family that they enter showbiz but end up in hospital, requiring the Goodies to act as their replacements.

videos.title: Earthanasia
videos.overview: It's Christmas Eve, and as The Goodies prepare for Christmas they learn that the world is about to end.

videos.title: Politics
videos.overview: Graeme is faced with selling the image of two potential Prime Ministers to the nation; Bill as the revolutionary Che Monyou and Tim as the stunning Timita.

videos.title: Saturday Night Grease
videos.overview: Bill decides to open Disco Bilius and introduces a mixed dancing competition.

videos.title: A Kick in the Arts
videos.overview: The British Olympic team is broke. Tim joins them and competes against Graeme and Bill's Rest of the World team.

videos.title: U-Friend or UFO?
videos.overview: The strange alien abductions of trombonists prompt Bill to solve the mystery.

videos.title: Animals
videos.overview: Tim becomes an animal rights activist, so Bill becomes a vegetable rights activist and a Watership Down parody ensues.

videos.title: War Babies
videos.overview: The Goodies are grown-up babies who are sent off to boarding school during the war years, and are asked by Churchill to go behind enemy lines to buy him a box of German cigars.

videos.title: Snow White 2
videos.overview: The Goodies find themselves living next door to Snow White and the seven dwarfs.

videos.title: Robot
videos.overview: Due to dire financial conditions, Bill is fired and replaced with a baby robot; however Tim and Graeme need help with raising it and hire a strange, bearded, Swedish nanny.

videos.title: Football Crazy
videos.overview: Bill the soccer hooligan is in fine form as Tim becomes Chief of Police in a bid to stamp out such boorish conduct, with football then becoming so boring that its fans flock to the ballet instead.

videos.title: Big Foot
videos.overview: The Goodies set off to the Canadian Rockies in search of the mythical Arthur C. Clarke, but find all sorts of other weird creatures including the legendary Bigfoot.

videos.title: Change of Life
videos.overview: Bill's 40th birthday makes the Goodies decide to close the business due to old age.

videos.title: Holiday
videos.overview: A supposedly relaxing holiday in the seaside village of Dunsquabblin turns very stressful when the Goodies are trapped inside for 17 days due to heavy rain and snow.

videos.title: Animals are People Too
videos.overview: Graeme's pet shop has a special new line - people dressed up as animals, but they also suffer from being dumped so Tim sets up a protection society, while Graeme cruelly puts the strays to work.

awards: Nominated for 2 BAFTA 2 wins & 3 nominations total
